introHtml: Poly propylene folders offer a durable, waterproof alternative to paper folders, making them ideal for outdoor events, trade shows, or any environment where documents need protection. Unlike standard cardstock, these folders resist tearing and spills, ensuring your branded materials stay crisp. Perfect for marketing directors and safety managers who need reliable, long-lasting giveaways that keep their message visible. Decorate with full-color print or foil stamp for a polished look.
heroAltText: Custom poly propylene folders with full-color print, durable and waterproof for outdoor events
